OwnerSet(address).notice: Emitted when the ownership of a merkle tree distribution is transferred.

PendingRootRevoked(address).notice: Emitted when the pending root is revoked by the owner or an updater.

PendingRootSet(address,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Emitted when a new merkle root is proposed.

RootSet(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Emitted when the merkle root is set.

RootUpdaterSet(address,bool).notice: Emitted when a merkle tree updater is added or removed.

TimelockSet(uint256).notice: Emitted when a merkle tree distribution timelock is set.

acceptRoot().notice: Accepts and sets the current pending merkle root.

claimed(address,address).notice: The `amount` of `reward` token already claimed by `account`.

ipfsHash().notice: The optional ipfs hash containing metadata about the root (e.g. the merkle tree itself).

isUpdater(address).notice: The addresses that can update the merkle root.

owner().notice: The address that can update the distribution parameters, and freeze a root.

pendingRoot().notice: The pending root of the distribution.

root().notice: The merkle root of this distribution.

setOwner(address).notice: Sets the `owner` of the distribution to `newOwner`.

setRoot(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Forces update the root of a given distribution (bypassing the timelock).

setRootUpdater(address,bool).notice: Sets the root updater of a given distribution.

setTimelock(uint256).notice: Sets the timelock of a given distribution.

timelock().notice: The timelock related to root updates.

userdoc.notice: This contract enables the distribution of various reward tokens to multiple accounts using different permissionless Merkle trees. It is forked from and heavily inspired by Morpho's Universal Rewards Distributor. The original implementation can be found at: https://github.com/morpho-org/universal-rewards-distributor
